general_information.Description: This course provides an overview of the M&A process – from strategy and valuation to execution and post-merger integration management. Students develop an in-depth understanding of the appropriate skills and tools to successfully analyze all major elements of the acquisition process discussed in the local and global context. The course will require the application of what the student previously learned in other courses such as finance, accounting, business law, micro and macroeconomics, negotiation, and management. - Teaching method: Lectures, in-class practice assignments, problem-solving discussions, and team-based activities.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Actively participate in class activities - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time. - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose. - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

description: This course provides an overview of the M&A process – from strategy and valuation to execution and post-merger integration management. Students develop an in-depth understanding of the appropriate skills and tools to successfully analyze all major elements of the acquisition process discussed in the local and global context. The course will require the application of what the student previously learned in other courses such as finance, accounting, business law, micro and macroeconomics, negotiation, and management. - Teaching method: Lectures, in-class practice assignments, problem-solving discussions, and team-based activities.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Define the common terminology in M&A, key characteristics of expected M&A transactions and the evolution of M&A
Evaluate the mechanism of M&A takeover tactics and defenses as well as explain the importance of corporate governance in M&A
Apply the typical phases of M&A process from developing strategy and acquisition plan, through preparing for negotiating deals, and postmerger or post-closing integration
Demonstrate understanding of business valuations basics
Analyze corporate exit strategies as a result of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, spin-offs, bankruptcy, liquidation
Discuss alternative deal structures such as alliances, joint ventures, partnerships, licensing, franchising, etc.

Demonstrate the ability to produce a clear oral report and/or academic written report, which follows research ethic, that applies understanding of key concepts in international merger and acquisitions.
Practice the ability to investigate and cooperate with others effectively in teams to manage M&A deal structuring process

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Comprehensive reading, understanding issues, presenting problems, Personal qualities: Individual responsibility, self-esteem, sociability, self-management, and integrity. Cover all studied chapters Any plagiarism will be resulted in a failure of assignment
assessments.Grading Guide: - Guided by instructor - Example of group assignment: Students will divide into “teams” of four-to-six to research, analyse, and do field work if necessary to design a viable corporate acquisition proposal. The purpose of the Acquisition Project is to give students the opportunity to apply the tools they have learned. Students are expected to write up a professional report that describes their methodology with clear adjustment of their choice of models, findings and discussion and implications. Finally, students need to present their work in class to instructors and other groups. Reports are graded to groups and presentation is graded on individual.
